project.title: Organoid differentiation with IL22
project.projectDescription: Differentiation of human organoids with IL22, and/or the inhibition of the same process with STAT3 or mTOR inhibitors.
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: Organoids were lysed in 8M urea, 50mM ammonium bicarbonate, and lysate was reduced with 5mM DTT, alkylated with 10mM iodoacetamide, and digested sequentially with Lys C, and Trypsin overnight. Peptides were pre-fractionated on c18 resin at high pH, into 5 fractions, and analysed as consecutive fractions by LC-MS/MS.
project.dataProcessingProtocol: Raw files were searched against the Uniprot Human database, using Maxquant/Andromeda. Differential analyses were performed with Perseus.
